Sandbox_ALifeRelations_Tags_tooltip: Off hides faction tags for every player, whatever they set in Options. Met factions are still recorded.
Sandbox_ALifeRelations_TagRange_tooltip: How far away faction tags show. Also how close an NPC must be for its faction to count as met.
Sandbox_ALifeRelations_MapMarks: Outpost marks on the world map
Sandbox_ALifeRelations_MapMarks_tooltip: Off stops marking outposts on the world map for every player, whatever they set in Options.
Sandbox_ALifeRelations_DiscoverRadius_to: How close a player must get to an outpost for it to be marked on their map.
Sandbox_ALifeRelations_TalkAnywhere_tool: On: the right-click Say and Shout menus show everywhere. Off: Say only shows with an A-Life NPC within 12 tiles, Shout within 25 (how far A-Life hears them).
